articles.title: Tokenized commodities look beyond gold as lending and oil open new markets
articles.snippet: Paxos Labs, Theo and Energy Substantiation execs see growth coming from putting physical assets to work, with precious metals leading and energy presenting a tougher test.

articles.title: Ledger investigates potential wallet tampering after reports of $86 million in crypto stolen
articles.snippet: The hardware wallet maker said it is investigating devices sold by a Southeast Asian reseller as social posts swirl about crypto assets drained from Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron addresses.

articles.title: Thailand opens door to locally listed bitcoin and ether ETFs
articles.snippet: Thailand’s new crypto rules taking effect Oct. 16. They allow Thai asset managers to launch crypto ETFs on the local stock exchange, with bitcoin and ether initially eligible.

articles.title: CFTC proposals aimed at separating prediction markets from casino gambling
articles.snippet: The two measures attempt to set the stage for a potential US Supreme Court battle over federal and state jurisdiction.

articles.title: Trump administration outlines quantum, AI initiatives in $6B science push
articles.snippet: The White House outlined a $215 million quantum computing competition and $2.4 billion in AI industry commitments as concerns grow over quantum threats to cryptocurrency security.
